intro.fr: Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio sort Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name en 2023.
text.en: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio releases Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name in 2023.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub zorasknight/YakLaDGaiRando, qui héberge l'APWorld de Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name.
text.en: The GitHub repository zorasknight/YakLaDGaiRando, home of the Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, Yakuza Gaiden Closed Beta for Testing (préversion).
text.en: The first version, Yakuza Gaiden Closed Beta for Testing (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version Beta-3, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (4 versions publiées).
text.en: Version Beta-3 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (4 versions released).

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Yakuza | Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
